records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Asian Film
records.description: Asian film from a cultural perspective. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 111, ASIA 111, JAPANESE 111.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Traditional Chinese Culture
records.description: Cultural development of China from early times through the golden age of Chinese civilization. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 120, ASIA 120, HUMANITY 120.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Modern Chinese Culture
records.description: An introduction to the culture of modern China, including Hong Kong and Taiwan. All readings in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 121, ASIA 121.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Traditional Japanese Culture
records.description: Traditional Japanese society and culture from ancient themes to the 19th century. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as JAPANESE 120, ASIA 122.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Modern Japanese Culture
records.description: Issues, trends, and forms of popular culture that define modern and contemporary Japanese life. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as JAPANESE 123, ASIA 123.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Masterpieces of Asian Literature
records.description: Introduction to Asian literature. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 131, ASIA 131, HUMANITY 131, JAPANESE 131.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Global Issues, Regional Realities
records.description: Introduction to the study of interconnections of global and local issues and themes; universalizing and particularizing tendencies in contemporary societies.  Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as FOR LANG 220, ASIA 220.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: India: History and Culture
records.description: Survey of South Asian history, societies and cultures - development of civilization and contemporary societies of India and South Asia. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 270, ASIA 270.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Southeast Asian History: Vietnam to Indonesia
records.description: Historical introduction to Southeast Asian social, religious, political, economic and cultural institutions including Vietnam, Thailand, Burma, the Philippines and Indonesia. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 271, ASIA 271.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Introduction to Middle Eastern History
records.description: History of the Middle East from Muhammad to the present; political and religious development and the impact of empires. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 272, ASIA 272.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Islam in Global History
records.description: Charts spread of Islam among the world's peoples, Islamic contributions to world heritage, and Islam's role in modern global affairs. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 273, ASIA 273.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Introduction to East Asian Culture
records.description: Survey of East Asia (China, Japan, Korea, and others) history from 1766 BCE to the present. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 275, ASIA 275.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Arts of Asia
records.description: Art and architecture of India, China and Japan within their historical, religious and cultural contexts. (Crosslisted course offered as ART 302, ASIA 302.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Topics in Asian Studies
records.description: Topics in Asian Studies.

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Studies in East Asian Film
records.description: Variable content seminar. In-depth study of East Asian cinema that brings together the analysis of cinematography, cultural, and sociopolitical backgrounds, and the impact and influences within an international context. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 311, JAPANESE 311, ASIA 311.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Issues in East Asian Ethics
records.description: Philosophical foundations of ethical thought in East Asia; informed responses to modern ethical dilemmas. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as JAPANESE 320, ASIA 320, CHINESE 320, HUMANITY 320.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Gender and Love in East Asian Culture
records.description: The theme of gender with respect to love, courage, self-sacrifice, and vulnerability in traditional Chinese and Japanese literature and culture. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 321, ASIA 321, JAPANESE 321.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Ecology in East Asian Cultures
records.description: Major ecological issues in East Asia through cultural representations, and analysis of their implications to the U.S. (Crosslisted course offered as ASIA 322, CHINESE 322, HUMANITY 322, JAPANESE 322.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: The Art of War
records.description: The philosophy behind war, military strategy and its consequences and representation in literature and film from East Asia. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 330, ASIA 330.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: The Middle East and the West
records.description: East-west tensions in the context of historical relations between the Middle East and West Europe since the rise of Islam. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 371, ASIA 371.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: The Middle East Since World War I
records.description: Developments in the Middle East since World War I, including nationalism, fundamentalism, and revolution. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 372, ASIA 372.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Chinese Civilization
records.description: Growth of Chinese civilization from the Bronze Age to the present. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 373, ASIA 373.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Japanese Civilization
records.description: Overview of Japanese history from the Stone Age to the present, including political, social, economic, and cultural history. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 374, ASIA 374.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Modern Japanese History
records.description: Examination of political, socioeconomic and cultural changes and the international crises in modern Japan since the 19th century. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 377, ASIA 377.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: The Two Koreas in the Modern World
records.description: Korean history, society, and culture with an emphasis on the two Koreas' standing within the global order. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 378, ASIA 378.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: World War II in Asia and the Pacific
records.description: Imperial rivalries in Asia; Japanese militarism; military, ideological and social aspects of the war; the atomic bomb; memory of the war. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 387, ASIA 387.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Modern South Asia: Community and Conflict
records.description: Historical transformation of communities and communal conflicts in modern South ASIA from 1500 to present; themes: caste, religion, geography, environment and economy. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 474, ASIA 474.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: The People's Republic of China, 1949 to Present
records.description: The major political, social, economic and cultural developments during the People's Republic of China. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 475, ASIA 475, POL S 475.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Revolutionary China, 1800 to Present
records.description: Continuity and change in the political, social, cultural and economic experience of China since 1800. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 476, ASIA 476, POL S 476.)

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Medicine, Science, and Technology in World History
records.description: The emergence of modern technological society with emphasis on scientific development and exchange among world civilizations across history. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 483, ASIA 483.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ASIA
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
